papers.title_en: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
papers.authors: Haoyang Luo, Junhao Qin, Jingyan Cao, Yi Huang, Guangjie Yang, Xiaoyu Chen, Haotao Lu, Tianxiang Gui, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
papers.evidence: 面向异构机器人协作的智能体操作系统与行为树
papers.tldr: 异构机器人团队需跨多本体完成长时任务，但现有系统难以将执行纠错沉淀为可复用经验，也缺乏跨时空任务记忆与显式机器人间依赖表示。InstAgent将团队行为组织为智能体行为树，显式建模能力分配、机器人依赖与交接检查，并通过递归自改进机制利用执行反馈更新协作程序、保留成功修订。共享多模态时空记忆为规划与交接验证提供上下文。在20个真实多机器人任务、三种高层模型上，任务成功率、首次尝试完成率与执行效率均稳定提升，显示其可积累协作经验。
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous robot teams enable complex, long-horizon tasks by combining complementary sensing, mobility, and manipulation capabilities across multiple embodiments. Yet existing systems struggle to retain execution-time corrections as reusable experience, maintain task-relevant context memory across space and time for reliable handoffs, and explicitly represent the inter-robot dependencies required for structured collaboration. In order to address these challenges, we present InstAgent, a recursively self-improving (RSI) Agent Operating System for heterogeneous robot collaboration. InstAgent organizes team behaviors as agentic behavior trees (BTs) that explicitly model capability assignment, inter-robot dependencies and handoff checks. The RSI mechanism updates these collaboration programs from execution feedback and preserves successful revisions for reuse in future tasks, while shared multimodal spatio-temporal memory provides context for planning and handoff validation. Experiments on 20 real-world multi-robot tasks with three high-level models show consistent gains in task success, first-attempt completion, and execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: From Sliding Windows to Self-evolving Lifelong Memory: A Dual-perspective Survey of Memory Paradigms for Long-Horizon Robotics VLA Models
papers.authors: Yong Wang, Boyu Shen, Xinwei Zhang, Yizheng Li, Keyuan Luo
papers.evidence: 长时程具身VLA智能体的记忆范式
papers.tldr: 长时程机器人任务中，VLA模型受限于有限时序上下文，难以积累与复用历史经验，记忆因此成为关键能力。该综述按记忆范围与持久性提出五类范式及一个新兴前沿的统一分类，并比较代表性系统的记忆特性、架构复杂度与开源成熟度。分析发现架构越复杂，开源成熟度通常越低。文章进一步讨论全生命周期记忆管理、终身知识演化等挑战，为具身终身智能提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic tasks expose a fundamental limitation of current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models because their restricted temporal context pre-vents effective accumulation and reuse of past experiences. As a result, memory has become a fundamental component for enabling embodied agents to perform long-horizon reasoning and adaptive decision-making. This survey presents a systematic taxonomy of VLA memory mechanisms based on memory scope and persistence, categorizing existing approaches into five representative paradigms and one emerging frontier. Based on this taxonomy, we compare representative VLA memory systems in terms of memory characteristics, architectural com-plexity, and open-source maturity, revealing a clear trade-off in which increasing architectural complexity is generally accompanied by decreasing open-source ma-turity. Finally, we discuss the key challenges in building full-lifecycle memory systems, including efficient memory management and lifelong knowledge evolu-tion. Overall, this survey provides a unified perspective on memory architectures for VLA agents and offers insights into the development of lifelong embodied in-telligence.

papers.title_en: Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
papers.authors: Kevin Chen, Yu-Wei Zhan, Haoran Liang, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向长时程具身世界模型的结构化潜在动力学
papers.tldr: 长时程具身世界模型在递归预测中易偏离连贯物理演化。HWM把骨干潜变量表示为广义坐标与动量的学习相位空间，用耗散哈密顿动力学前向传播，并经可学习逆接口映射回原潜空间，同时加入多步转移监督。受控仿真中速度、加速度和加加速度估计更准，长时程能量漂移显著降低；在Ctrl-World、EVAC和Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B上均有效，RoboCasa任务成功率相对提升2.7%，真实AgiBot轨迹nDTW提升9.7%、Logic提升8.4%。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

papers.title_en: ForagerSim: Evaluating Embodied Map-Based Reasoning in Large-Scale Dynamic Worlds
papers.authors: Tomáš Musil, Martin Kotík, Michal Vavrečka, Karla Štěpánová, Sebastian Scherer, Martin Saska
papers.evidence: 动态世界中的具身地图推理基准
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能依赖易受动态环境影响的手工建图，或学习策略难以形成地图式表征，且缺少要求地图推理的基准。ForagerSim 是模块化仿真平台，沿感知、尺度、拓扑、动态和任务等难度轴评测大规模动态世界中的具身地图推理。在 8 个世界中对比强化学习、工程化机器人栈与人类玩家，发现学习策略在简单拓扑的二维感知任务上表现良好，但在更大或更复杂拓扑中落后于人类与地图基线。这表明地图式推理是此类场景的关键瓶颈，并提供了可扩展评测平台。
papers.abstract_en: Animals build cognitive maps of vast environments, use them to perform map-based navigation, and might even be reusing the same circuitry used in spatial reasoning for creating and using maps of arbitrary task-spaces. In contrast, current embodied AI systems either rely on hand-engineered mapping pipelines, which break in the presence of unmodeled dynamics and are restricted to metric space, or on learned policies that rarely form map-like representations at all. Developing architectures that could learn to build and use map-like representations as flexibly as animals is, however, difficult because few embodied AI benchmarks actually require map-based reasoning. To address this, we present ForagerSim --- an interdisciplinary research platform and simulation environment focused on embodied tasks that require map-based reasoning, with scenarios ranging from mobile-robot search and rescue to animal foraging in both complex mazes and vast, potentially infinite open areas. ForagerSim is highly modular and allows modifying independent axes of difficulty related to perception (abstract 2D sensing to full RGB or LiDAR), scale (room-scale to multi-km scale), topology (open-fields to complex mazes), dynamics (smoke, debris, sensorimotor failures and others) and tasks (from simple 2D coverage to foraging-inspired well-alternation tasks). We compare reinforcement learning baselines with a simple engineered robotics stack and a human player on 8 example worlds which show how different difficulty axes affect existing methods. Our results show that, when sensing is simplified to 2D, learned policies can perform multi-object search and well-alternation tasks surprisingly well in simple topologies, but they fall short of human performance in larger or more complex-topology environments where map-based baselines perform well, suggesting that map-based reasoning is the bottleneck in these scenarios.

papers.title_en: Beyond Omni: A Unified MLLM for Embodied Sensory Understanding
papers.authors: Shiyun Xiong, Dongming Wu, Peiwen Sun, Bokang Yang, Jiaxu Wang, Xiaolou Sun, Mingxing Wen, Xiangyu Yue
papers.evidence: 面向多样物理感官感知的统一具身多模态大模型
papers.tldr: 现有具身系统多依赖多模态大模型，但物理世界感知仍局限于视觉、音频等基础模态，难以覆盖深度、触觉、雷达等异构传感信号。为此，作者提出统一具身多模态大模型框架 Unisense，采用两阶段训练：先将传感表示与语言对齐，再在共享大模型中调优模态专家，并构建覆盖8种模态的 Unisense-1M 语料。在12个基准上，Unisense 于多数异构传感任务中优于通用与专用模型。该工作展示了预训练 MLLM 作为统一具身感知模型的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.

papers.title_en: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
papers.authors: Ni Zhang, Haofeng Yuan, Jianan Zhou, Shiji Song, Zhiguang Cao
papers.evidence: 基于大语言模型的外生世界模型预测未来作业到达，用于动态调度与规划
papers.tldr: 动态调度需在线分派任务并预判未来作业，分派不当会在非线性延迟目标下放大下游成本。本文把预训练大语言模型作为结构化世界模型的外生部分，借助afterstate分解将确定性车间转移与不确定到达分离，让LLM只预测后者。据此提出AWMP，结合信念条件分派策略与短场景推演，并用惊讶触发刷新和在线残差自校准应对非平稳到达。在动态作业车间和柔性作业车间基准上，加权延迟分别降低6-21%和22-46%，优于八种经典优先分派规则中的最佳者。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

papers.title_en: Mobile Embodied Agent Network (MEAN): Integrated Framework, Enabling Technologies, and Task-Driven Deployment
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Zhang, Lingxiao Sun, Weijie Zhou, Chunhui Feng, Zhaohui Yang, Xuan Cheng, Tianyi Qin, Zhixian Kong, Baoping Cheng, Zijian Wu, Jingze Che
papers.evidence: 融合感知、通信与行动的移动具身智能体网络综述
papers.tldr: 移动网络正从以人和数据为中心转向以机器与具身智能体为主的任务导向平台，但感知、通信、计算、决策与行动闭环缺乏统一组织框架。本文提出移动具身智能体网络（MEAN）范式，构建网络资源与智能功能协同支撑具身任务执行的统一框架，并将性能指标扩展到任务结果与跨层系统效应。进一步梳理大模型认知、令牌通信语义连接和强化学习闭环适配三类互补机制，以及MEAN与新兴技术的双向作用。该综述为任务导向网络的设计、部署与后续研究提供了系统化参考。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile networks are evolving from human-centered, data-oriented communication infrastructures toward machine- and/or agent-dominant, task-oriented platforms that are to serve the rapidly increasing networked machines and embodied agents. In order to fulfill the newly arose complex task objectives, the framework of future mobile network is to be innovated to reflect and facilitate the intrinsic interplay and integration of the underlying processes of perception, communication, computation, decision, action, and feedback, etc. This survey establishes the mobile embodied agent network (MEAN) as a task-oriented networking paradigm in which networking and distributed intelligence are jointly organized around closed-loop embodied task execution. We first establish a unified MEAN framework that explains how network resources and intelligent functions jointly support embodied task execution, and extend its performance indicators from conventional communication metrics to embodied task outcomes and cross-layer system effects. With this framework, we analyze three complementary enabling mechanisms that form a cognition-interaction-adaption loop. Large artificial intelligence (AI) models provide high-level cognition, token communication connects this cognition with distributed agents through shared semantic representations, and reinforcement learning closes the loop by adapting system operation to network, task, and physical feedback. We further investigate the bidirectional interplay between MEAN and emerging technologies, showing how they mutually extend system capabilities and reshape task-oriented network design. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future research directions toward the practical realization of MEAN over real joint communication and computation platform.

papers.title_en: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
papers.authors: Kabir Swain, Sijie Han, Antonio Torralba
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能与机器人训练的环境生成平台
papers.tldr: 具身智能训练亟需大规模、多样、可交互且经过验证的虚拟环境，以提升策略泛化能力并支撑可复现评测。EnvDreamer利用大语言模型与视觉语言模型自动生成Unreal Engine 5场景，覆盖导航、交互与操作任务，并支持定制采样和真实图像条件重建。仅在这些生成环境中训练的策略，无需显式建图或人工任务监督，便在多个具身基准上取得有竞争力结果。作者进一步发布EnvDreamer-20k数据集，包含2万个验证环境及任务程序、场景图和轨迹，推动具身智能基准复现。
papers.abstract_en: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

papers.title_en: Awkernel: RTOS Bridging DAG Scheduling Theory and Component-Oriented Real-Time Systems Practice
papers.authors: Atsushi Yano, Ryo Nishimura, Yutaro Kobayashi, Yuuki Takano, Takahiro Ishikawa-Aso, Takuya Azumi
papers.evidence: 面向组件化实时系统支持DAG调度的实时操作系统
papers.tldr: 实时DAG调度理论缺乏原生OS支持，CORTS平台又难保证时序可分析性。Awkernel作为首个开源RTOS原生支持DAG调度研究，提供模块化调度器、随机负载生成器和内置指标，并以发布/订阅与FasS API将回调映射为子任务。树莓派4上调度开销达微秒级，GEDF仅226行，实践者无需理解DAG语义即可移植自动驾驶部分系统。它桥接理论与CORTS实践，兼顾算法评测与可分析部署。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time directed acyclic graph (DAG) scheduling provides a rigorous basis for timing analysis and efficiency in component-oriented real-time systems (CORTS) such as autonomous driving systems, yet challenges remain from the perspectives of both theorists and practitioners. For theorists, no OS natively supports the DAG task model; algorithms are therefore evaluated only analytically or in simulation, ignoring real-hardware overheads. For practitioners, today's CORTS platforms (ROS~2 and AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform) are designed for service composition rather than timing analyzability; adopting DAG scheduling research therefore demands substantial code changes and developer discipline. This paper proposes Awkernel, the first open-source real-time operating system (RTOS) that natively supports real-time DAG scheduling research, bridging DAG scheduling theory and CORTS practice. For theorists, Awkernel is a real-hardware testbed: it exposes a modular OS-native DAG scheduler for easy algorithm implementation, plus a random workload generator and built-in metrics for evaluation. For practitioners, Awkernel is not a full replacement for today's platforms but a CORTS platform maximizing timing analyzability: its familiar publish/subscribe model keeps porting mechanical, mapping each callback to one subtask. Moreover, its function-as-subtask (FasS) API enforces DAG semantics (precedence constraints) without programmer discipline, yielding applications that match the theoretical DAG model and directly inherit its efficiency and safety guarantees. On a Raspberry Pi~4, microbenchmarks confirm microsecond-level scheduling overheads; a global earliest deadline first (GEDF) scheduler fits in 226~lines; and a practitioner ports part of an autonomous driving system using only the FasS API, without reasoning about DAG semantics.

papers.title_en: Optimal Dynamic Resource Allocation for Multicore Real-time Systems
papers.authors: Georgiy A. Bondar, Abigail Eisenklam, Ripon C. Sarker, Linh Thi Xuan Phan, Abhishek Halder
papers.evidence: 多核实时系统中带硬截止期的动态资源分配
papers.tldr: 针对多核实时系统中硬截止期约束下的动态资源分配难题，该文将其建模为带资源边界的数据驱动最优控制问题。作者在温和假设下证明了问题可行性与最优解存在性，并据此设计了求解多核动态资源分配的算法。在真实多核平台上用四个基准测试验证了算法的实用性。该工作为硬实时约束下的动态资源管理提供了可证明且可落地的优化框架。
papers.abstract_en: We formulate a novel optimal control problem for data-driven dynamic resource allocation in multicore real-time systems. The proposed formulation accounts for hard deadline constraints and resource bounds. Under mild assumptions, we prove several results on the feasibility and existence of optimal solution for the proposed formulation. Building on these analyses, we design an algorithm to solve the multi-core dynamic resource allocation problem. We demonstrate the practical use of this new algorithm by experimentally evaluating it on a real multicore platform using four benchmarks from the literature.

papers.title_en: From Social Reasoning to Embodied Interaction: An Agentic Framework for Social Robots
papers.authors: Ziyu Cheng, Yuewen Guo, Zhirui Liu, Dong Zhang, Haotao Lu, Jingyi Yu, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
papers.evidence: 连接智能体推理与具身表达的社交机器人框架
papers.tldr: 现有社交机器人难将多模态推理、长期记忆与实体表达闭环结合，基础模型智能体又缺乏身体。ARISE在Sophia人形机器人上统一智能体推理与交互式社交具身，融合多模态理解、长期记忆及反应/主动交互，并通过流式执行把社交意图转化为手势、语音与机械面部表情的协调行为。评测显示交互质量、表达协调性与延迟均改善。该工作强调同时推理“说什么、何时参与、如何表达”对人机自然交互的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Natural face-to-face human--robot interaction requires a robot to understand an evolving social situation, decide when to engage, and express its intent through coordinated physical behavior. Yet existing approaches rarely close this loop: foundation-model agents provide increasingly capable multimodal reasoning and memory but remain largely disembodied, while expressive virtual agents do not face the physical constraints of real robots, and physical social robots typically address social reasoning and embodied expression only partially. We present ARISE, a unified framework that bridges Agentic Reasoning and Interactive Social Embodiment on the Sophia humanoid robot. ARISE integrates multimodal context understanding, long-term memory, and reactive and proactive interaction to determine when and what to communicate, and translates social intent into robot-native gestures coordinated with speech and mechanical facial expressions through streaming execution. Extensive evaluations on Sophia demonstrate strong perceived interaction quality, expressive and well-coordinated embodied behavior, and substantial latency reductions through streaming execution. These results highlight the importance of jointly reasoning about what to communicate, when to engage, and how to physically express social intent for natural interaction with humanoid robots. Project Page: https://robosocial.github.io/

papers.title_en: Dynamic Control of a Make-to-Order Manufacturing System under Throughput Time Constraints: An Effective Computational Method in the High-Dimensional Case
papers.evidence: 按订单生产系统中的动态排程控制
papers.tldr: 面向价格与交付时间敏感客户的按订单生产系统，需在吞吐时间约束下联合决定动态定价、调度与外包。研究将多类排队网络近似为重交通下的多维布朗控制问题，并设计适配高维情形的神经网络求解方法。由此把近似解还原为集成的动态定价、外包与调度策略，并在两个文献测试问题的仿真中验证其有效性。该工作为高维按订单生产系统的实时控制提供了可计算方法与管理洞见。
papers.abstract_en: We consider dynamic control of a make-to-order production system that serves price- and delay-sensitive customers. The production system is modeled as a multiclass queueing network where the customers' delay sensitivity is modeled via throughput-time constraints. To maximize her profit while meeting these throughput time constraints, the system manager uses three different types of control: i) dynamic pricing decisions; ii) dynamic order-of-service (scheduling) decisions; and iii) outsourcing decisions upon arrival of new orders. We approximate this problem by a multi-dimensional Brownian control problem in heavy traffic, and develop a neural network-based computational method tailored for high-dimensional problems. By interpreting the solution in the context of the original model, we propose an integrated dynamic pricing, outsourcing, and scheduling policy. The effectiveness of this policy is demonstrated through a simulation study of two test problems drawn from the literature.

papers.title_en: Constrained Federated Reinforcement Learning for Secure Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing
papers.authors: Zhiyu Wang, Muhammed F. Esgin, Mohammad Goudarzi
papers.evidence: 车联网边缘计算中的DAG任务卸载与资源分配
papers.tldr: 面向车载边缘计算中DAG依赖子任务卸载与跨区域协同学习的安全需求，提出CRAFT约束强化联邦卸载框架。该方法将卸载与资源分配建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，结合集中式评论家、拉格朗日松弛与两层联邦聚合及近端正则化。在墨尔本CBD真实网络与计算内核测试中，加权成本最高降低42%，任务完成率约96%，安全开销仅6.4%。
papers.abstract_en: Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. Confidentiality and integrity for federated parameter exchange are provided by post-quantum homomorphic encryption and lattice-based signatures with modest amortized overhead. On a Virtual Machine-based testbed over a realistic Melbourne Central Business District network with real computation kernels, CRAFT cuts weighted cost by up to 42% over state-of-the-art baselines, maintains a completion rate of around 96%, and adds 6.4% security overhead.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Runtime Prediction and Conservative Walltime Policies in HPC Systems
papers.authors: Hector Romero Ugalde, Youssef Faqir-Rhazoui, Marlon Funk, Jesus Gorroñogoitia Cruz
papers.evidence: 面向高性能计算作业调度的保守墙钟时间推荐框架
papers.tldr: HPC作业常因用户高估walltime导致资源利用率与调度效率下降。论文提出与预测器无关的SAFE决策层，将运行时预测转换为保守且有界的walltime建议。在Fugaku约2400万和Eagle约1100万作业上评估，结合相似性感知预测，walltime差距降低约20%至26%，作业终止率低于1%。该框架把预测模型模块化，为生产环境安全部署提供可复用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient use of large-scale supercomputing systems depends on accurate runtime estimation and walltime selection. To avoid premature termination, users often overestimate walltime, leading to poor resource utilization and reduced scheduling efficiency. This paper presents a predictor-agnostic framework for safe walltime recommendation in production HPC environments. Rather than proposing a new runtime prediction model, the primary contribution is the SAFE decision layer, which converts predicted runtimes into conservative bounded walltime recommendations suitable for deployment. Runtime prediction is therefore treated as a modular component within the proposed framework. We evaluate the approach using large-scale production job histories from the Fugaku and NREL Eagle supercomputers, comprising approximately 24M and 11M jobs, respectively. Runtime prediction performance is first evaluated using representative predictors, including linear regression, neural networks, and a neural ensemble. The proposed SAFE framework is then evaluated using the NN ensemble predictor. Experimental results indicate that similarity-aware prediction substantially improves runtime estimation for workloads similar to previous executions. When combined with the proposed conservative walltime recommendation policies, these improvements enable walltime gap reductions of approximately 20 - 26% while maintaining job termination rates below 1% across both systems.

papers.title_en: Resource-Aware Scheduling for Distributed Quantum Computing
papers.authors: Connor Howe, Raghav Mundada, Jake O'Shaughnessy, Ibrahim Abdullahi, Ali Anwar
papers.evidence: 面向分布式量子计算的资源感知运行时调度器
papers.tldr: 分布式量子计算需在单QPU完整执行、切割后顺序执行与多QPU分布式执行间做运行时选择。本文提出资源感知调度器，用QPU执行、通信和宿主端重建的显式模型比较方案，并以模拟IBM QPU的硬件时序支撑决策。实验显示重建占切割开销83%以上，分布式执行相对不切割单QPU将P90延迟最多降低39%，调度开销不足端到端延迟的0.038%。这表明DQC应作为量子与经典资源的运行时调度问题处理，而非仅做电路划分。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed quantum computing (DQC) is a promising near-term approach for executing circuits that exceed the capacity of a single quantum processing unit (QPU). Prior work has made significant progress on circuit partitioning and reconstruction, but practical DQC requires more than cutting a circuit into smaller pieces. A runtime system must determine whether to execute the circuit intact, cut it for sequential execution on one QPU, or distribute it across multiple QPUs, while accounting for queueing, communication, reconstruction, and hardware constraints. We present a resource-aware scheduler for DQC that compares these execution alternatives at runtime using explicit models of QPU execution, communication, and host-side reconstruction, together with hardware-informed timing derived from simulated IBM QPUs. By treating communication and reconstruction as first-class scheduling costs, the scheduler selects execution plans using a more realistic view of end-to-end overhead than cutting-only approaches. Across our experiments, reconstruction accounts for over 83% of cutting overhead, distributed execution reduces P90 latency by up to 39% relative to uncut single-QPU execution, and scheduling overhead itself remains negligible, never exceeding 0.038% of end-to-end job latency. Together, these results show that DQC must be treated as a runtime scheduling problem over both quantum and classical resources, not just circuit partitioning.

papers.title_en: Data Center Load Accommodation under QoS and Checkpoint-Induced Frequency Security Constraints
papers.authors: Ruolan Cui, Ziang Liu, Chenxi Hu, Francis Yunhe Hou
papers.evidence: 兼顾工作负载服务质量与负荷平移的数据中心负荷接纳优化
papers.tldr: AI负载推动数据中心并网，传统可承载容量评估常假定灵活性必然增益，却忽略同步检查点造成的快速降载与频率风险。本文构建兼顾QoS、检查点频率安全和电网充裕性的最优DCLA方法，并联合优化储能配置与运行。算例表明基准方法高估容量达40.3%，QoS是主要约束，训练负载增加时频率安全约束更紧。该工作揭示可靠DCLA须同时计入电网支撑价值与QoS、FS风险。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence workloads is accelerating the expansion and grid interconnection of data centers (DCs). Existing data center load accommodation (DCLA) assessments primarily focus on grid and resource adequacy and often imply that greater workload flexibility always increases accommodable capacity. However, workload flexibility has a dual effect. Workload deferral and temporal shifting can alleviate network congestion, whereas synchronized checkpointing of training workloads can cause large and rapid load reductions, threatening frequency stability. Therefore, DCLA cannot be determined solely by grid adequacy. This paper develops an optimal DCLA method that jointly accounts for workload quality of service (QoS), checkpoint-induced frequency security (FS), and grid adequacy. First, a QoS-aware model characterizes workload-dependent flexibility while ensuring service feasibility. Second, checkpoint-induced FS constraints are developed for periodic and event-triggered power variations, with key frequency-security limits reformulated in algebraic form. Third, a two-stage lexicographic model is developed to maximize DCLA and minimizes the required energy storage (ES) deployment, and then optimizes system operation under the given DC and ES siting and sizing decisions. Case studies show that the proposed method avoids a 40.3% overestimation of DCLA compared with the grid-adequacy benchmark. QoS is the primary limiting factor, while checkpoint-induced frequency-security constraints become more restrictive as training workloads increase. These findings highlight that reliable DCLA should account for both its grid-support value and the associated QoS and FS risks.

papers.title_en: LonGaussian: Tracking Foundation Priors for Long-Context Feedforward Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zhoufeng Xie, Guanjun Wu, Shuai Zhang, Xinggang Wang, Wenyu Liu
papers.evidence: 服务机器人感知与具身智能的三维场景重建
papers.tldr: 长视频前馈高斯重建受限于全视角联合处理的显存开销，以及逐像素累积造成的表面重复表示。LonGaussian 构建流式前馈框架，基于预训练流式三维重建主干，将长上下文几何特征解码为稠密高斯；在每个分块内用多帧点跟踪关联同一表面的重复观测，并由学习式合并器压缩对应高斯预测。它还利用渲染深度一致性过滤跨块错误遮挡的高斯。在 DL3DV 与 RealEstate10K 上，该方法以显著更少的高斯数量提升新视角渲染质量。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing high-quality, renderable 3D scenes from long videos is essential for robotic perception and embodied intelligence. Many feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction methods rapidly predict 3D scenes from a small set of images, but extending them to longer sequences presents two bottlenecks: jointly processing all views increases GPU memory requirements, while accumulating pixel-aligned predictions redundantly represents the same surfaces and increases storage and rendering costs. We present LonGaussian, a streaming feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact, globally renderable Gaussian scenes from long image sequences with known intrinsics and unknown camera poses. Built on a pretrained streaming 3D reconstruction backbone, LonGaussian decodes long-context geometric features into dense Gaussians. Within each chunk, multi-frame point tracks link repeated observations of the same surface and guide a learned merger to consolidate the corresponding Gaussian predictions. Rendered-depth consistency filtering further suppresses Gaussians from other chunks that incorrectly occlude locally reconstructed surfaces. On DL3DV and RealEstate10K benchmarks, LonGaussian improves novel-view rendering quality while using substantially fewer Gaussians than the evaluated feed-forward baselines.

papers.title_en: A Partial Duty Formulation for Crew Scheduling
papers.authors: Twan Dollevoet, Bart van Rossum, Remy Spliet
papers.evidence: 带约束的乘务排班用列生成求解
papers.tldr: 针对含休息、工作时间和值勤长度约束的乘务排班问题，传统以完整值勤为变量的集合划分模型其LP界被证明弱NP难。作者提出以部分值勤为变量的替代模型，使LP界可多项式时间计算，并分析对应定价问题复杂度。该模型LP界较弱，但引入兼容性割可完全弥补损失；因分离后定价仍弱NP难，又给出两种松弛割。基于部分值勤模型的diving启发式在鹿特丹地铁网络实验中显示计算优势。
papers.abstract_en: We consider a crew scheduling problem with a break, working time, and duty length constraint. It is common to solve crew scheduling problems with a diving heuristic, using column generation to solve the LP relaxation of a set partitioning formulation where variables correspond with duties. We prove that computing the LP bound of this formulation is weakly NP-hard, and propose an alternative formulation based on partial duties, whose LP bound can be computed in polynomial time. We prove the same complexity results for the corresponding pricing problems. However, the partial duty formulation has a weaker LP bound. To overcome this issue, we introduce compatibility cuts which completely recover the loss in LP bound. While separation can be done efficiently, we prove that the corresponding pricing problem after separation is weakly NP-hard. Therefore, we also introduce two relaxed versions of the compatibility cuts. We demonstrate computational benefits by providing numerical experiments with a diving heuristic based on the partial duty formulation, in a case study on the metro network of the Rotterdam area, the Netherlands.

papers.title_en: Non-Monetary Mechanisms for Stochastic Scheduling via Sampled Pairwise Externality Compensation
papers.authors: David X. Lin, Chido Onyeze, Giannis Fikioris, Siddhartha Banerjee, Éva Tardos
papers.evidence: 非货币化的在线资源分配与调度机制
papers.tldr: 无货币共享资源分配中，需求私有随机、任务可排队且参与者可能策略化或对抗时，个体效用保障是难题。本文提出SPEC非货币在线机制，以采样估计替代未来外部性精确计算，并用耦合模拟保持高效与稳健。在单服务器随机调度中，简单策略可达知情规划者最优最坏情形理想效用比例，仅有次线性加性损失。任务越持久该比例越趋近1，且每期期望摊还开销O(n^2)且不随时间跨度T增长。
papers.abstract_en: How can a shared resource be allocated without money when agents have private, stochastic demands that can be queued for a while, and may behave strategically, or even adversarially? We introduce a paradigm for non-monetary online resource allocation called Sampled Pairwise Externality Compensator (SPEC). Our objective is to guarantee each agent a large fraction of its ideal utility: an individual benchmark corresponding to serving the highest-valued fraction of its demand permitted by an equal share of capacity. We seek guarantees that hold regardless of other agents' behavior, including potentially adversarial and collusive behavior. Our approach builds on the idea of pairwise externality compensation, making it computationally efficient by replacing exact calculations of future externalities with sampled estimates. The central insight is that local mixing, exploited through coupled simulations, allows these estimates to be computed efficiently while preserving robust utility guarantees. In our main technical contribution, we instantiate SPEC in a stochastic scheduling model in which agents receive jobs with private values, unserved jobs persist across periods subject to random expiration, and a single server processes at most one job per period. Our mechanism gives each agent a simple strategy that achieves the optimal worst-case fraction of ideal utility available to a fully informed planner, up to a sublinear additive loss in total utility. We also show that this fraction approaches $1$ in the long-horizon limit as the expiration probability vanishes: sufficiently persistent jobs allow each agent to secure nearly its full ideal utility. The mechanism runs in $O(n^2)$ expected amortized time per period, where $n$ is the number of agents; significantly, the expected amortized computational overhead per period is independent of the time horizon $T$.
